title: GPT-3 powers the next generation of apps
summary: Over 300 applications are delivering GPT-3–powered search, conversation, text completion, and other advanced AI features through our API.
body: Over 300 applications are delivering GPT-3–powered search, conversation, text completion, and other advanced AI features through our API.
summaryZh: OpenAI宣布超过300个应用程序正通过其API提供由GPT-3驱动的搜索、对话、文本补全以及其他高级AI功能，标志着大语言模型在现实世界中的规模化商业应用取得进展。

aiReview.reasonZh: 官方数据展示了早期GPT-3在数百个真实应用场景中的落地情况。
